"""Offline local color-midpoint proposal; no labels or cutting paths are inputs."""
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage as ndi

def local_modes(probability, window_fraction=.1, separation_fraction=.8):
    p=np.asarray(probability,dtype=np.float64)
    if p.ndim!=2 or p.shape[0]!=p.shape[1] or not np.isfinite(p).all() or p.min()<0 or p.max()>1:
        raise ValueError('Expected finite square probabilities in [0,1]')
    window=int(round(p.shape[0]*window_fraction))|1
    smooth=ndi.gaussian_filter(p,1)
    total=ndi.uniform_filter(smooth,size=window)
    variance=np.maximum(ndi.uniform_filter(smooth*smooth,size=window)-total*total,0)
    bins=np.minimum((smooth*32).astype(int),31)
    mass=np.zeros(p.shape);moment=np.zeros(p.shape)
    best=np.full(p.shape,-1.);low=np.zeros(p.shape);high=np.ones(p.shape);balance=np.zeros(p.shape)
    for b in range(31):
        selected=bins==b
        mass+=ndi.uniform_filter(selected.astype(float),size=window)
        moment+=ndi.uniform_filter(smooth*selected,size=window)
        a=moment/np.maximum(mass,1e-12)
        z=(total-moment)/np.maximum(1-mass,1e-12)
        between=mass*(1-mass)*(z-a)**2
        better=(mass>=.1)&(mass<=.9)&(between>best)
        best=np.where(better,between,best)
        low=np.where(better,a,low);high=np.where(better,z,high);balance=np.where(better,np.minimum(mass,1-mass),balance)
    explained=np.maximum(best,0)/np.maximum(variance,1e-12)
    supported=(explained>=separation_fraction)&(high-low>=.15)&(((low<.15)&(high<.7))|((high>.85)&(low>.3)))
    threshold=np.where(supported,(low+high)/2,.5)
    mask=p>=threshold
    return mask,{'window':window,'activeFraction':float(np.mean(supported)),'changedFraction':float(np.mean(mask!=(p>=.5)))},threshold

 src=by[row['id']];rgb=Image.open(source/'inputs'/src['assets']['crop.png']['path']).convert('RGB');n=rgb.width

 auto=np.array(Image.open(row['assets']['auto']['file']).convert('L'))>127;new=np.array(Image.open(row['assets']['0.1']['file']).convert('L'))>127
 if np.mean(auto[valid]!=truth[valid])>.5:truth=~truth
 error=np.full((n,n,3),255,dtype=np.uint8);error[valid & (auto!=truth)]=[0,90,255];error[valid & (new!=truth)]=[240,40,20]
 panels=[rgb,Image.fromarray(np.uint8(auto)*255).convert('RGB'),Image.fromarray(np.uint8(new)*255).convert('RGB'),Image.fromarray(error)]
 out=Image.new('RGB',(n*4,n+45),'white');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(out)
 for k,(im,title) in enumerate(zip(panels,['Photograph','Automatic mask','Local two populations','Blue: old error; red: new error'])):out.paste(im,(k*n,45));draw.text((k*n+5,8),title,fill='black')
 out.save(root/(row['id']+'-review.png'))
 boundary=np.zeros(auto.shape,dtype=bool);boundary[1:]|=truth[1:]!=truth[:-1];boundary[:,1:]|=truth[:,1:]!=truth[:,:-1]
 d=ndi.distance_transform_edt(~boundary);added=valid&(new!=truth)&(auto==truth)
 print(row['id'],'new errors',int(added.sum()),'within3px',float(np.mean(d[added]<=3)))
# Same restored real crop/probability used by the preceding diagnosis. Model inputs are only p.
old=Path('tmp/heart-learning/color-boundary-v1/fusion-colors');p=np.fromfile(old/'mixture.f32',np.float32).reshape(400,400);rgb=Image.fromarray(np.fromfile(old/'rgb.bin',np.uint8).reshape(400,400,3))
real=root/'real';real.mkdir(exist_ok=False);rows=[];panels=[rgb];names=['Fixed restored photo']
for width in [.05,.1,.16]:
 m,details,t=local_modes(p,width);f=real/(str(width)+'.bin');f.write_bytes(m.astype(np.uint8).tobytes());Image.fromarray(np.uint8(~m)*255).save(real/(str(width)+'.png'))
 rows.append({'width':width,'mask':str(f),'sha256':sha(f),'details':details});panels.append(Image.fromarray(np.uint8(~m)*255).convert('RGB'));names.append('Local populations '+str(width))
out=Image.new('RGB',(1600,445),'white');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(out)
for k,(im,title)in enumerate(zip(panels,names)):out.paste(im,(400*k,45));draw.text((400*k+5,8),title,fill='black')
out.save(real/'review.png');(real/'proposals.json').write_text(json.dumps({'probabilitySha256':sha(old/'mixture.f32'),'rows':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
